Diversify AI exposure beyond mega-caps. Favor AI security (defensive) over speculative AI buildout. Watch for dot-com correction signals.
Lock in fixed-rate mortgages now. Favor REITs over residential exposure. Monitor 30Y rate above 7%.
Historical data shows limited impact. Maintain diversified portfolio. Avoid political event trading.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Fed meeting with inflation tick-up creates rate hike risk. Bond market stress (10Y 4.94%) pressures equities but dot-com comparison suggests resilience. Geopolitical oil risk (Houthis, Iran) is primary wildcard. AI regulation debate adds noise. Expect 2-4% volatility range. Mortgage rate surge weighs on housing-adjacent names.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI security, GLP-1 pharma, and REIT dividends offer structural growth. Canada and select EMs attract capital rotation. Dot-com comparison is a warning but not a prediction. Midterm history supports market stability. Key risk: sustained oil shock above $100 Brent could reprice inflation and force aggressive Fed tightening.
